maya: Quick async — I need short Q2 milestone statuses for the exec deck. For each milestone: one-line status (shipped/slipped/partial), owner, blockers, ETA. Please reply by EOD. cc @alex-prod @kevin-eng

alex-prod: Dedicated-tier autoscale — shipped to canary last week. Owner: @alex-prod. Blocker: minor telemetry gap for cost breakdown. ETA for full rollout: 2026-04-02. :shipit:

kevin-eng: Runtime v2 perf regression milestone — slipped. Owner: @kevin-eng. PRs merged but failing long-sequence perf tests on Ampere nodes. Blocker: suspected kernel regression, tracking with @eng-infra. ETA tentative: 2026-04-09. Ping @srini-ml for perf baselines.

srini-ml: Will re-run end-to-end evals tomorrow AM. Suspect quant flag mismatch introduced in last compile job — filed issue #458. If infra is green I'll have numbers by 3/26.

nina-pm: Eval harness + regression alerts — partial. Owner: @nina-pm. Blocker: legal needs to sign off on golden prompt subset (privacy review). ETA current: 2026-03-31 if legal delivers.

kevin-eng: Also FYI code review backlog: PRs `#1342` (runtime perf fixes) and `#1350` (telemetry schema). Need reviewers. To reproduce locally run: `./scripts/perf-check --long` and `make test-integration`.

maya: Assigning reviewers — @alex-prod can you pick up `#1350` tomorrow? @kevin-eng you own `#1342` but if you need a second reviewer tag someone from eng-sre. @nina-pm can you escalate legal?

alex-prod: I can take `#1350` tomorrow morning, got it. :+1:

nina-pm: Legal looped in and promised subset by 2026-03-28. I'll escalate if not received by EOD.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: canary -> staging for "Dedicated-tier autoscale" at 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z (automated).

kevin-eng: One more blocker note — eng-infra has a maintenance window 2026-03-30 -> 2026-03-31 which may delay perf infra runs. @eng-infra any chance to nudge that?

srini-ml: If maintenance holds, I'll move heavy evals earlier and queue shorter runs during window. Suggest we target perf gating on 2026-03-29 to keep rollout timeline.

maya: Thanks all — I'll collate these into one-line statuses and share in #all-hands. If anything slides beyond the ETAs above, update this thread. Quick async follow-up Friday AM.
